summary.text: Cathy Kenny is a Republican state representative from New Hampshire House District Hillsborough 13 who has served in the New Hampshire House of Representatives since 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She lives in Hudson, New Hampshire, and works as a manager.

paragraphs.text: Cathy Kenny lives in Hudson, New Hampshire.
Her career experience includes working at Bensons Animal Park, managing Amherst Animal Hospital, serving as a science aide at Bedford High School, and as an amateur farmer, according to Ballotpedia.
Kenny volunteered with the Nashua Emblem Club #170, Opportunity Networks Nashua, the Nashaway chapter of New Hampshire Audubon, Nashua Soup Kitchen and Touchstone Equine Therapy Programs.
Kenny has represented Hillsborough 13 since the 2022 election and was assigned to the Environment and Agriculture Committee for the 2023-2024 session, according to Ballotpedia.
